lines.label: B1
lines.reason: Base plate 1 to the long +y down-flange 4 (89.8 deg). In sections at t=0.02/0.25/0.5/0.75/0.98 the line sits on the outer arc apex: outer surface along the bisector is within 0.00-0.06 mm. Apex points stop within about 0.5 mm of both ends (x -30 to +29), so the line covers the full fold.

lines.label: B2
lines.reason: Base plate to the -y flange 9 to the right of the notch (90.4 deg). Sections show it on the outer apex (offset -0.02 to 0.10 mm). Apex continues only about 1.5 mm past the start into the notch corner radius; the rest of the 27.7 mm fold is covered.

lines.label: B3
lines.reason: Base plate to the -y flange 10 to the left of the notch (89.6 deg). It is a separate fold, offset about 4.7 mm in y from B2 with the notch between them, so a separate line is correct. On the outer apex at all stations (0.00-0.07 mm) and covers the full extent from x=-30 to -4.4.

lines.label: B4
lines.reason: Joggle bend 1, from the base plate up into the wall (89.9 deg). Outer skins are plate 2 and wall 11, and sections confirm the line on the convex outer apex (0.01-0.06 mm). Sections past the ends show a corner relief at y about -20.8 and only edge/flange points beyond y=+21.4, so the shorter extent than B5 is real and the coverage is full.

lines.label: B5
lines.reason: Joggle bend 2, from the wall into the raised plate 3 (90.2 deg). Outer skins are plate 3 and wall 12. On the outer apex at all stations (0.01-0.04 mm), with no apex points beyond either end (y -22.05 to 21.72).

lines.label: B6
lines.reason: Raised plate 3 to its +y down-flange 14 (90.4 deg). On the outer apex at all stations (0.00-0.03 mm) and spans the whole flange (x 34 to 54).

lines.label: B7
lines.reason: Raised plate to the end up-tab 15 (86.3 deg bend; tab tilts about 4 deg). Outer skins are plate underside 5 and tab outer 15, and sections confirm the outer apex (0.00-0.08 mm). Covers the full 11.7 mm tab root.
